_note: Prose that wraps the zone NUMBERS in article tables. The numbers themselves live in data/zones.csv and reach templates through site/_data/zones.js -- never type a percentage into this file. Created August 12, 2026 when four published articles were converted from hand-typed zone tables to the generated `zoneTable` shortcode. OVERLAP TO RESOLVE: zonesUi.json also carries `zoneNames` (Spanish only), because the calculator UI predates this file. Two homes for the same seven labels is exactly the drift this whole exercise exists to stop -- fold zonesUi's names into this file during the EN/PT calculator translation pass, which is the natural moment because that pass has to add en/pt to zonesUi anyway. Logged in open-loops.md.
